methodology: Seven deterministic shared-profile workloads. Five fresh Node processes per engine/workload, rotated order, 150 ms warmup, calibrated batches targeting 10 ms, 21 samples per process. Medians across trial medians. HTML strings are materialized and normalized output hashes must agree across all trials and engines (including removal of formatting newlines before nested lists). Summary is an equally weighted geometric mean of per-workload speed ratios, not a pooled latency. MiniText still returns AST plus HTML; competitors return HTML. No cache, optional features, equal-compliance or universal-speed claim. Baseline is optional and points to an untouched build of the original source.
